title: P1 Trustworthy Autonomous Production Task Backlog

scheduling_policy.dependency_rule: A task may enter ready/in_progress only after every depends_on task is done, except the single declared initial_ready_task.
scheduling_policy.concurrency_rule: Tasks with satisfied dependencies may run concurrently when they do not change the same canonical authority contract.
scheduling_policy.promotion_rule: done means implementation plus task acceptance evidence; maturity promotion remains a separate signed accountability action.
scheduling_policy.accountability_materialization_rule: Planned ACC-P1-* identifiers reserve accountability identity. A task may become in_progress only after its record is materialized in the canonical accountability ledger with a signed start event.
scheduling_policy.phase_rule: A later phase may prototype only where lane/task dependencies are satisfied; maturity promotion never bypasses phase dependencies.
